specsRaw.Ready for Everyday Life: With 100 meters of water resistance, the Sunburst is ready for rain, the pool, weekends by the water, and wherever life takes you. As with most watches, we recommend avoiding hot water and scuba diving.
specsRaw.Distinctive Design: — Watches made to stand out, not blend in.
specsRaw.Premium Quality: — Premium style and quality without the premium price.
specsRaw.Easy Strap Changes: — Quick-release straps let you change the look in seconds, no tools required.
